The 2025–26 Scottish Championship (known as the William Hill Championship for sponsorship reasons) was the 13th season of the Scottish Championship, the second tier of Scottish football. The season began on 1 August 2025.[1]

Ten teams contested the league: Airdrieonians, Arbroath, Ayr United, Dunfermline Athletic, Greenock Morton, Partick Thistle, Queen's Park, Raith Rovers, Ross County and St Johnstone.

[edit]

The following teams changed division after the 2024–25 season.

From Championship

Relegated to League One

  • Hamilton Academical

Promoted to the Premiership

  • Falkirk
  • Livingston

Results

[edit]

Teams play each other four times, twice in the first half of the season (home and away) and twice in the second half of the season (home and away), making a total of 180 games, with each team playing 36.
